title: Implement minimal arbitrage module with computation and logging

requirements.text: Create frontend/src/lib/arbitrage.ts module exporting set_arbitrage(p1: number, p2: number) function that computes p3 = p1 - p2 and returns object { p1, p2, p3 }

quotes: Create arbitrage.ts (or similar) exporting: set_arbitrage(p1: number, p2: number) → computes p3 = p1 - p2 and returns { p1, p2, p3 }

acceptanceCriteria: Function accepts two numeric parameters p1 and p2
Computes p3 as p1 minus p2
Returns object with properties { p1, p2, p3 }
Function is exported from the module

requirements.text: In frontend/src/lib/arbitrage.ts, export get_arbitrage(p1: number, p2: number) function that internally calls set_arbitrage, logs the resulting { p1, p2, p3 } object to console, and includes a TODO comment for future payout and Merkle-root integration

quotes: get_arbitrage(p1: number, p2: number) → internally calls set_arbitrage, logs { p1, p2, p3 }, and adds a TODO comment for future payout + Merkle-root integration

acceptanceCriteria: Function accepts two numeric parameters p1 and p2
Internally calls set_arbitrage(p1, p2) to compute result
Logs the { p1, p2, p3 } object to console.log
Includes TODO comment mentioning future payout integration and Merkle-root integration
Function is exported from the module

requirements.text: In the existing order creation flow on frontend/src/pages/Products.tsx, after computing the order total, call get_arbitrage(p1 = total, p2 = mockWholesalePrice) where mockWholesalePrice is calculated as 80% of p1 (total * 0.8)

quotes: In the existing order creation flow, after computing the total, call get_arbitrage(p1 = total, p2 = mockWholesalePrice) where mockWholesalePrice can be a fixed number (e.g. 80% of p1)

acceptanceCriteria: Import get_arbitrage function from frontend/src/lib/arbitrage.ts into Products.tsx
After computing order total in the mock order creation handler, calculate mockWholesalePrice as total * 0.8
Call get_arbitrage(total, mockWholesalePrice) to compute and log arbitrage values
No money is sent and no external service integration occurs
Arbitrage computation happens before or after the order API call without blocking order creation

constraints: Do not send any money or integrate with any external payment service
Do not modify the backend/main.mo file
Do not implement actual payout logic or wallet integration
Keep arbitrage computation as a pure logging operation
nonGoals: Implementing Merkle root batch job functionality
Real payout execution or wallet integration
Storing arbitrage computation results in backend or database
